say:0:1027402001:0.text: It's her again! How'd she get so far ahead of us?!
say:0:1027402001:0.source_cn: 又是那个宝藏猎人！她怎么又抢先一步了？！

say:2:1027403001:1.text: You were so slow in getting here that I couldn't help sneaking a peek at the puzzle.
say:2:1027403001:1.source_cn: 你们来得也太慢了，我差点就忍不住偷看谜题了。

say:3:1027403002:1.text: Let's have a little contest and see who can solve it first.
say:3:1027403002:1.source_cn: 来比比看吧，谁能先解开这道题目。

choice_prompt:4:1027403002.text: Let's have a little contest and see who can solve it first.
choice_prompt:4:1027403002.source_cn: 来比比看吧，谁能先解开这道题目。

say:5:1027403003:1.text: How are you the one complaining? I'm the one that's been sitting here waiting for you.
say:5:1027403003:1.source_cn: 能让我在宝物线索面前等这么久，你们还有什么不满？
say:5:1027403003:1.male: How are you the one complaining? I'm the one that's been sitting here waiting for you.
say:5:1027403003:1.female: How are you the one complaining? I'm the one that's been sitting here waiting for you.

say:6:1027403005:1.text: Alright, alright, go ahead and read the inscription.
say:6:1027403005:1.source_cn: 好了好了，快去看碑文吧。
say:6:1027403005:1.male: Alright, alright, go ahead and read the inscription.
say:6:1027403005:1.female: Alright, alright, go ahead and read the inscription.

say:8:1027403004:1.text: I wouldn't be so sure about that!
say:8:1027403004:1.source_cn: 哼，输的人是谁还不一定呢~
say:8:1027403004:1.male: I wouldn't be so sure about that!
say:8:1027403004:1.female: I wouldn't be so sure about that!

say:2:1027404001:1.source_cn: 嗯，这道谜题倒是很简单嘛。

say:3:1027404002:1.text: The four altars from top to bottom are "Water", "Wind", "Wood", and "Earth". Just pair them with the appropriate offering.
say:3:1027404002:1.source_cn: 四个祭坛，从上往下依次是“水”、“木”、“风”、“土”...

say:4:1027404003:1.text: "Water" should correspond to fish, and the fruit should be paired with "Wood". Your turn.
say:4:1027404003:1.source_cn: “水”对应的是鱼，“木”对应树上结出的果实——该你了。
say:4:1027404003:1.male: "Water" should correspond to fish, and the fruit should be paired with "Wood". Your turn.
say:4:1027404003:1.female: "Water" should correspond to fish, and the fruit should be paired with "Wood". Your turn.

choice_prompt:5:1027404003.text: "Water" should correspond to fish, and the fruit should be paired with "Wood". Your turn.
choice_prompt:5:1027404003.source_cn: “水”对应的是鱼，“木”对应树上结出的果实——该你了。
choice_prompt:5:1027404003.male: "Water" should correspond to fish, and the fruit should be paired with "Wood". Your turn.
choice_prompt:5:1027404003.female: "Water" should correspond to fish, and the fruit should be paired with "Wood". Your turn.

say:8:1027404005:1.text: ...Not bad. Seems we actually do make a decent team.
say:8:1027404005:1.source_cn: ……唔，不错，看起来我们确实有合作的资格。
say:8:1027404005:1.male: ...Not bad. Seems we actually do make a decent team.
say:8:1027404005:1.female: ...Not bad. Seems we actually do make a decent team.

say:9:1027404006:1.text: So we're tied. Even more impressive when you consider we didn't even get a half day's head start, like you!
say:9:1027404006:1.source_cn: 不分上下！前提是某些人真的没有提前偷看题目，冥思苦想了...

say:10:1027404007:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style> figured out the answers after just a single glance!
say:10:1027404007:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style> figured out the answers after just a single glance!
say:10:1027404007:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style> figured out the answers after just a single glance!

say:11:1027404008:1.text: Hey, Bunny Boy, remind me how much you contributed to the puzzle.
say:11:1027404008:1.source_cn: 嘿，兔耳朵小哥，你在解密里又出了多少力？！

say:12:1027404009:1.text: I...I... enlivened the atmosphere with my positive demeanor! And gave <style="stress"><player_name></style> some much-needed support!
say:12:1027404009:1.source_cn: 我——我——充分活跃了气氛！而且给予了<style=s...
say:12:1027404009:1.male: I...I... enlivened the atmosphere with my positive demeanor! And gave <style="stress"><player_name></style> some much-needed support!
say:12:1027404009:1.female: I...I... enlivened the atmosphere with my positive demeanor! And gave <style="stress"><player_name></style> some much-needed support!

choice_prompt:13:1027404009.text: I...I... enlivened the atmosphere with my positive demeanor! And gave <style="stress"><player_name></style> some much-needed support!
choice_prompt:13:1027404009.source_cn: 我——我——充分活跃了气氛！而且给予了<style=stress><player_name></style>应有的赞美！
choice_prompt:13:1027404009.male: I...I... enlivened the atmosphere with my positive demeanor! And gave <style="stress"><player_name></style> some much-needed support!
choice_prompt:13:1027404009.female: I...I... enlivened the atmosphere with my positive demeanor! And gave <style="stress"><player_name></style> some much-needed support!

say:14:1027404010:1.text: Do I detect a hint of sarcasm?
say:14:1027404010:1.source_cn: 感觉你在阴阳怪气，是我的错觉吗？
say:14:1027404010:1.male: Do I detect a hint of sarcasm?
say:14:1027404010:1.female: Do I detect a hint of sarcasm?

say:15:1027404011:1.text: So, where should we start finding what to offer to the altars? Any ideas?
say:15:1027404011:1.source_cn: 很好，那么接下来，祭品去哪里找，你们有头绪吗？

say:16:1027404012:1.text: Especially you, Floppy Ears, put that tiny gizmo between them to work, and think!
say:16:1027404012:1.source_cn: 尤其是你，兔耳朵小哥，让你双耳之间那个小玩意运转起来—...

choice_prompt:17:1027404012.text: Especially you, Floppy Ears, put that tiny gizmo between them to work, and think!
choice_prompt:17:1027404012.source_cn: 尤其是你，兔耳朵小哥，让你双耳之间那个小玩意运转起来——好好思考！

say:18:1027404013:1.text: I got this! Ta-da! Authentic feathers from Bryon's companion, the lovely Elona!
say:18:1027404013:1.source_cn: 当然！铛铛！如假包换的翎羽！来自布莱恩的伙伴，美丽的艾洛娜！

say:19:1027404014:1.text: And for the record, I picked these feathers up when she shed them! Completely harmless, there was no plucking involved!
say:19:1027404014:1.source_cn: ——事先声明，这是她脱羽时我捡的！完全无害！绝对没有拔毛！

choice_prompt:20:1027404014.text: And for the record, I picked these feathers up when she shed them! Completely harmless, there was no plucking involved!
choice_prompt:20:1027404014.source_cn: ——事先声明，这是她脱羽时我捡的！完全无害！绝对没有拔毛！

say:23:1027404015:0.text: As for me, I'll get fish for "Water"... Oh! There are plenty of fishmongers in Lunadorf. I'll go buy one and come back soon.
say:23:1027404015:0.source_cn: “水”的鱼……正好，月湖村有不少村民酷爱钓鱼，我去买一...

choice_prompt:24:1027404015.text: As for me, I'll get fish for "Water"... Oh! There are plenty of fishmongers in Lunadorf. I'll go buy one and come back soon.
choice_prompt:24:1027404015.source_cn: “水”的鱼……正好，月湖村有不少村民酷爱钓鱼，我去买一条吧，很快就回来。

say:25:1027404016:1.text: Hmph, you guys are taking all the easy ones.
say:25:1027404016:1.source_cn: 哼，还真是会捡轻松的活儿啊。

choice_prompt:26:1027404016.text: Hmph, you guys are taking all the easy ones.
choice_prompt:26:1027404016.source_cn: 哼，还真是会捡轻松的活儿啊。

say:27:1027404017:1.text: ...But the gem I have on me right now is an incredibly rare gemstone!
say:27:1027404017:1.source_cn: ……啧，好吧，好吧，比起鹿灵的宝藏，一两块宝石而已……

say:28:1027404018:1.text: *Sigh* ...Alright, alright, I suppose parting with one gem is worth the vast treasure of the Deer Spirit.
say:28:1027404018:1.source_cn: 可恶……那可是纯净度很高、很稀少的宝石！不是随随便便能...

say:29:1027404019:1.text: Go find the rest of the offerings, and I'll wait for you here.
say:29:1027404019:1.source_cn: 你们去找其余祭品吧，我在这儿等你们收集回来。
say:29:1027404019:1.male: Go find the rest of the offerings, and I'll wait for you here.
say:29:1027404019:1.female: Go find the rest of the offerings, and I'll wait for you here.

narration:30:1027404020:0.text: After everyone finishes collecting the offerings...

choice:26:1:2.source_cn: 宝藏猎人应该不缺宝石吧

choice:13:1:2.text: We can't thank you enough, Lorsan.
choice:13:1:2.male: We can't thank you enough, Lorsan.
choice:13:1:2.female: We can't thank you enough, Lorsan.

say:2:1027406001:1.text: Phew... good, just as I expected, altars that test wisdom don't usually consume their offerings.
say:2:1027406001:1.source_cn: 呼……太好了，如我所料，这种考验智慧的机关祭坛通常不会...

say:3:1027406002:1.text:
That gem does seem to be worth quite a lot...
I find your parting with it to be a bit suspicious if I'm being honest.
say:3:1027406002:1.source_cn: 的确，这宝石看起来就非常值钱……\n但你居然能把它拿出...

say:4:1027406003:1.text: I took the risk, Bun-Bun, because I have enough expertise to understand the nature of this altar.
say:4:1027406003:1.source_cn: 因为我足够渊博，知道祭坛的本质，才敢于冒险，兔耳朵。

say:5:1027406004:1.text: I won't let you get under my skin this time, you greedy treasure fiend!
say:5:1027406004:1.source_cn: 这次我可不会被你激怒，然后就被带偏话头了，贪婪的宝藏猎人。

say:6:1027406005:1.text: You obviously didn't realize you'd be able to get the gem back, and only relaxed once you did.
say:6:1027406005:1.source_cn: 你明明是直到刚才确认收回了宝石，才终于松了口气。

say:7:1027406006:1.text: Meaning you truly were willing to part ways with such an incredible stone.
say:7:1027406006:1.source_cn: 在此之前，你都是明知宝石被作为祭品牺牲掉的可能性，却甘...

say:8:1027406007:1.text:
So? Why does that matter?
As I said earlier, if there's treasure, we'll divide it according to everyone's equal efforts.
say:8:1027406007:1.source_cn: 所以，这说明什么？\n我前面也说过了，如果有宝藏，我们...

say:9:1027406008:1.text: I don't know how we'll split it, but I do know one thing—
say:9:1027406008:1.source_cn: 分不分成我不确定，但我至少可以猜出一件事——

say:10:1027406009:1.text: Whatever treasure you're after is definitely worth more to you than that gem.
say:10:1027406009:1.source_cn: 你想从宝藏中得到的东西，价值绝对高于这块美丽而昂贵的宝石。

choice_prompt:11:1027406009.text: Whatever treasure you're after is definitely worth more to you than that gem.
choice_prompt:11:1027406009.source_cn: 你想从宝藏中得到的东西，价值绝对高于这块美丽而昂贵的宝石。

say:12:1027406010:1.text: We become like the company we keep, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1027406010:1.male: We become like the company we keep, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:12:1027406010:1.female: We become like the company we keep, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:13:1027406011:1.text:
So, answer me, oh greedy little pilferer.
What exactly do you want from the Deer Spirit's treasure?
say:13:1027406011:1.source_cn: 所以，回答我吧，贪婪而不敬的宝藏猎人。\n你到底想从鹿...

say:15:1027406013:1.text: You've been yapping nonstop for half a day and still don't know what I want?
say:15:1027406013:1.source_cn: 你滔滔不绝了半天，连我想要什么都不知道吗？

say:16:1027406014:1.text: You, the devout one, seem to know less than me, the "greedy", insolent one. Funny, huh?
say:16:1027406014:1.source_cn: 虔诚的你，反而还不如我这个贪婪而不敬的人知道得多哦？

say:18:1027406016:1.text: Alright, we've wasted enough time bickering.
say:18:1027406016:1.source_cn: 好啦，我们已经浪费不少时间了，口舌之争就到此为止吧。

say:19:1027406017:1.text: I'm not waiting any longer to get to the next puzzle—first come, first serve!
say:19:1027406017:1.source_cn: 下个解谜我可不会再等了，先到者得！
